name: Genetic Condition
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:1>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Passive) This character has an uncommon 
genetic condition that, unlike a disease, 
gives positive special abilities, which 
include increased physical strength, 
dexterity, and reflexes, as well as an 
always-regenerating body that keeps itself 
perpetually youthful, never getting older 
than a teenage body, and having pure white 
skin as a fluke.  It runs in families yet 
is also found in people who are unrelated 
to each other.  Whether or not two people 
who have it are related or not, both will 
have the same facial features, and often, 
but not always, the same personality.  
People who have it are usually male.  In 
some cases the condition also limits 
mental maturity to that of a teenager as 
well, but not always.  It is not 
considered a disability, legally or 
otherwise.  
>

name: Class, Swordmaster
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) Swordmasters live and die by the 
sword, and know how to wield and fight 
with various types of swords and fighting 
styles, with one and two-handed swords, 
and also dual sword fighting styles.  Each 
has it's ups and downs.
>

name: Class, Axemaster
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) An Axemaster is much like a 
swordmaster, but their thing is axes and 
battleaxes of different types and fighting 
styles.  Axes, in general, are slower to 
attack with than swords, and can't block 
as easily, but with a good swing can cut 
deeper.
>

name: Class, Samurai
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The Samurai is a noble warrior who 
lives by ethics and honor, and not just 
their weapon of choice, the katana.  They 
can use magic points for spiritual sword 
attacks in combat, using their focus and 
spirit as they strike.
>

name: Class, Ninja
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The Ninja fights with not only the 
ninja's sword, the ninjato, but also with 
ninja magic that uses sneaky tricks of 
sorts that can disable, debilitate, blind, 
deafen, poison, and do more to enemies.
>

name: Class, Rifleman
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The Rifleman is a soldier and 
warrior who fights his/her opponents not 
with a sword or other blade, but with 
bullets and live hand grenades.  They use 
magic points for specialist spells that 
create and fling magical grenades, and 
their firearms can sometimes attack 
multiple opponents at a time.
>

name: Class, Cleric
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) A Cleric is a religious 
spellcaster that draws upon the power of 
his/her diety and religion for casting 
spells related to healing, curing diseases 
and curses, and bringing defeated 
companions back to life after they fall in 
combat.  Clerics are also good at fighting 
the undead.
>

name: Class, Combat Mage
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The Combat Mage, or simply Mage 
for short, is a specialist spellcaster 
that can only wield magics related to 
blasting things and directly causing 
damage from various magical elements, and 
not much else, and therefore has a limited 
number of spells they can cast, yet they 
are very good at the spells they cast, 
casting them better than a general wizard 
does.
>

name: Class, Wizard
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The wizard is a general 
all-purpose spellcaster that doesn't 
specialize in any specific type or sort of 
magic, but at the same time doesn't excel 
or have extreme skill in any type of magic 
either.  Their advantage is that they have 
a large number of spells to choose from in 
their spellbooks, for nearly any occasion.
>

name: Class, Martial Artist
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The Martial Artist is skilled in 
unarmed combat, knowing how to fight 
without weapons with a variety of 
techniques.  When equipped with their 
handbooks, they have a number of melee 
skills they can use.  As a backup, they 
have a few basic weapons they can also 
equip, as the usual primary and secondary, 
plus backup weapons.
>

name: Class, Kensei
note:
<tjsSpecialSkill><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsPriority:2>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageCustom>
<tjsInfo:
(Class) The Kensei is a sword master or 
"sword saint," and is a legendary 
individual of the world they live in.  
There is a maximum of only one Kensei in 
any world.  A kensei has extreme skill and 
expertise in all swords of all kinds, and 
is very special.  Becoming a kensei is a 
great honor that very few can ever hope to 
qualify for.  A kensei is also a legendary 
hero of outstanding accomplishment, with 
qualities that are unmatched and 
recognized by people of his or her world.  
>

name: Fast Recover HP
note:
<tjsMiscellaneous><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsSkillTypeName:Innate>
<tjsPriority:4>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageUses>
<tjsInfo:
With this ability, you take a second or 
two to catch your breath, refocus, and do 
something about any wounds you have.  Uses 
tactical points.  Amount healed varies and 
is dependent upon maximum HP.  Wounds heal 
without scarring, blemishes, pain, or 
permanant damage of any kind.  Even works 
with severed, missing body parts.  
Characters with a genetic quirk have this 
ability.
>

name: Protect
note:
<tjsMiscellaneous><tjsEquipType:N/A>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:N/A>
<tjsAimAdjust:0>
<tjsSkillTypeName:Samurai Ability>
<tjsPriority:5>
<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsMessageUses>
<tjsInfo:
(Samurai Ability) Using this ability, a 
samurai steps forward in front of their 
allies in battle, partially blocking the 
adventuring party's enemies from getting 
to the samurai's allies.  The samurai 
effectively makes it more likely that an 
enemy will attack himself / herself 
instead of his / her allies, whenever an 
enemy picks which of the adventuring party 
to attack.  When the samurai does this, it 
lasts for five turns.  
>

sleep in one enemy, if successful.

typically wake up after a few turns, or if 
they are hit by some type of attack that 
does any damage.  
>

name: Rage
note:
<tjsEquipType:book>
<tjsWeaponType:N/A>
<tjsArmorType:wizard's book>

<tjsSkillTypeName:Wizard Spell>

<tjsHalfPhysical:-1>
<tjsShowItemLevelInSkillCost>
<tjsMessageCasts>
<tjsInfo:
(Magic Spell) This spell induces magical 
rage in one enemy, if successful.  Enemies 
in combat that are magically enraged will 
attack their enemies endlessly without 
controlling themselves.  Player-controlled 
characters that are affected will blindly 
attack automatically, without having any 
normal options for that character to 
choose what to do in a combat turn.  Being 
struck with an attack that does damage can 
make an affected character "snap out of 
it" and break the spell early, otherwise 
it will eventually wear off.  
>
